text:
ops-bot: ALERT: bulk BMC update completed in eu1 at 03:21 UTC. Fleet health degraded: 28 nodes reporting oob timeouts, secureboot toggles detected.

alex: noticing provisioning errors for new GPU jobs since the update. Scheduler retries blasting the pool. capacity down ~12% (28/240 GPUs). :grimacing:

priya: putting this on triage. are the BMCs flipping secure boot state or just failing attestation?

marco: logs show a mix — ~18 nodes have secure_boot=1 unexpectedly set by the firmware, 10 nodes are responding with no attestation (timeout).

alex: repro snippet from the provisioner logs: ```
2026-03-21T03:29:10Z provisioner ERROR node=eu1-rack12-09: bmc: attestation timeout (read)
2026-03-21T03:29:11Z scheduler WARN job=job-4423: allocation retry (attempt=3)
```

priya: thanks. initial hypothesis: BMC agent applied patch and toggled UEFI Secure Boot policy on some boards (vendor patch). That causes our PXE / signed image checks to fail and triggers provisioning fallback which reboots and increases retry cost.

sasha: impact matrix: new-job latency ↑ 4x, failed allocations ↑ 2.8x, monthly cost projection +6% if retries keep going for >12h. Current rate: ~120 retries/minute.

oncall-ryan: I'm on it. pulling jump-host serials for affected rack12 nodes. @marco can you paste the exact sysfs/UEFI flag we should probe?

marco: check `efivar -l | grep SecureBoot` and `ipmitool lan print` for out-of-band reachability. Also look at BMC fw version header: `ipmitool mc info` — we see the patch build string `bmc-fw-2026.03.20-r2` on the impacted hosts.

alex: quick mitigation suggestion: pause provisioner autoscaling and reduce retry backoff to avoid thrash. We should also add a short-circuit that treats secureboot mismatch as a soft-fail allowing jobs to fall back to a signed compatibility image (low perf) until we fix BMCs.

priya: agreed. executing mitigation now: `POST /infra/provisioner/actions/pause?scope=eu1&reason=bmc-update` (runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/provisioning/bmc-mitigation)

ops-bot: playbook run started by priya (id=run-8221). Notifying oncall.

oncall-ryan: I've grabbed serial logs from eu1-rack12-09: early boot shows UEFI shell complaining about missing signature, then the BMC reboots the host during PXE. Sharing snippet: ```
Mar 21 03:24:12 UEFI: SecureBoot: signature check failed for /pxe/initrd.img
Mar 21 03:24:13 BMC: watchwdog: triggered reboot
```

sasha: can we roll forward a per-rack BMC rollback? We have a previous stable `bmc-fw-2026.02.17` in staging. Rolling back 28 machines might be faster than manual single-node fixes.

marco: rollback plan exists, but it requires 2-step redeploy (disable update lock, flash image, verify). It will cause brief OOB disconnects — need to coordinate with schedulers to drain first.

priya: cost tradeoff: rollback will incur 2-4 minute reboots * 28 nodes but avoid thousands of retry attempts. I vote rollback for rack12 and surrounding edge racks that share same fw path.

alex: +1. also add a short monitoring job to detect SecureBoot toggles automatically and alert before provisioners hit them.

oncall-ryan: starting targeted rollback for rack12. Steps: 1) annotate nodes `maintenance=rolling-bmc` 2) drain GPU allocations 3) execute flash script `scripts/oob/flash-bmc.sh --image bmc-fw-2026.02.17 --force` 4) verify attestation and efivar flags.

priya: I'm updating the incident doc: https://internal.incidents/redwood/INC-2026-312 (adding cost estimate and rollback timeline).

ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: provisioning paused in eu1 at 03:33 UTC. Analytics pipeline alerted on increased retries.

marco: FYI we should quarantine the pushed update in the internal artifact registry and tag it `hold` until vendor confirms change in secureboot default. I'll open a vendor ticket.

sasha: vendor ticket filed: VT-4552 "BMC update toggles UEFI SecureBoot". Included logs and sample node IDs.

alex: after rollback we should run a small canary (5 test allocations) using the signed-compat image and validate both OOB reachability and allocator behavior. If green, resume bulk provisioning.

oncall-ryan: rollback complete for rack12 at 03:48 UTC. efivar shows `SecureBoot = 0` on those nodes, attestation passing. Doing canary run now.

priya: canary passed. recommencing scaled provisioning with conservative retry backoff. Will monitor costs.

sasha: postmortem actions: 1) add Preflight check for BMC update that validates UEFI toggles 2) add automatic `secureboot` flag metric to fleet telemetry 3) vendor coordination for fix + signed manifest.

alex: thanks everyone. follow-up sync in #eng-infra-incident-review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
